about.title: about-me
about.p1: I was born in Uzbekistan and I am a dedicated front-end developer specializing exclusively in React. I focus on creating responsive, intuitive, and high-performance web applications from scratch.
about.p2: I write clean, modular, and maintainable code with JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and React. Ensuring pixel-perfect responsive layouts and seamless user experience is my primary goal.
about.more_info: In my projects, I focus on component reusability, modern state management (Zustand/Redux), and smooth REST API integration. Check out my GitHub repositories for my latest work.
